newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Empire jumps 10.71 pct on buy-in rumours.
newsitem.headline: Empire jumps 10.71 pct on buy-in rumours.

text.p: Property firm Empire East Land Holdings Inc jumped 45 centavos, or 10.71 percent, to 4.65 pesos in late trade on Tuesday on market speculation of a buy-in by a foreign company, brokers said.
But Empire East's President Gerardo Garcia said the company was unaware of any buy-in.
"I am not aware of that," Garcia told Reuters when asked about the talk in the market.
On Monday, Empire East shares had risen by 13.5 percent to 4.20 pesos.
Brokers said Singapore-based investors were buying heavily into Empire East.
"There are talks in the market that a Singapore group is interested to buy into the company," said one trader who requested not to be named.
Some 59.9 million Empire East shares changed hands as of 11:36 a.m. local time (0336 GMT).
